headline: This law renames a Postal Service building in Petersburg, Virginia, after John Mercer Langston.
what_it_does: It officially names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 29 Franklin Street in Petersburg, Virginia, the John Mercer Langston Post Office Building. The change is symbolic and does not change how the post office operates or delivers mail. Langston was a 19th-century lawyer, educator, and politician.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025.
